description: Upper-body garment category and cut taxonomy. length/fit/sleeve are ordinal axes; neckline/closure are nominal. Class lists and their order must match garment/descriptor.py AXIS_LABELS (checked by tests).

categories.label: tshirt
categories.definition: Light/medium upper garment; short, long or sleeveless. Includes t-shirts, polo t-shirts, tank tops, camisoles.
categories.source: Fashionpedia 'top, t-shirt, sweatshirt' (EXCLUDING nickname=hoodie) + Shopping100k T-shirt(4)

categories.label: sweatshirt
categories.definition: Thick upper garment, hooded (hoodie) or not, usually with ribbed cuffs. Sweaters/cardigans are NOT included; Shopping100k Jumper also contains knitwear, so labels from that source are noisy.
categories.source: Fashionpedia 'top, t-shirt, sweatshirt' with nickname=hoodie(16) + Shopping100k Jumper(5) (noisy)

categories.label: shirt
categories.definition: Buttoned, collared woven upper garment (shirt, blouse).

out_of_scope_categories: sweater, cardigan, jacket, coat, vest, dress, pants and all other categories are OUT (see mapping_categories.csv).

length.definition: Vertical garment length (not sleeve length). From Fashionpedia length attributes on-model; manual labels on flat-lay.

classes.label: crop
classes.definition: Above the waist; exposes the midriff. Fashionpedia nickname 'crop (top)' or micro/mini length.

classes.label: short
classes.definition: Above the hip; ends below the waist but above the hip.

classes.label: long
classes.definition: Below the hip and longer (tunic, above/below-the-knee, midi, maxi, floor).

fit.definition: How closely the garment fits the body. Ordered axis: distance between tight and oversize matters; within-one-class accuracy is used in evaluation.

sleeve.definition: Sleeve length. Main label source is Shopping100k sleevelen; sleeve-length labels effectively do not exist on Fashionpedia upper-garment masks (0.1%).

classes.label: sleeveless
classes.definition: No sleeves; spaghetti straps and strapless included.

classes.label: short
classes.definition: Upper arm; elbow-length included. Extra short + short + elbow.

classes.label: three_quarter
classes.definition: Below the elbow, above the wrist (3/4).

classes.label: long
classes.definition: Wrist length and longer (long, extra long, wrist-length).

neckline.definition: Neckline/collar type (nominal, auxiliary axis). From Shopping100k collar+neckline and Fashionpedia neckline part masks. Retailer labels are noisy; within-one-class tolerance does not apply.

classes.label: shirt_collar
classes.definition: Shirt collar (shirt, buttondown, kent, turndown, cutaway).

classes.label: other
classes.definition: Other closure types (lace up, wrapping, hook, belt...).

confidence_threshold.note: Initial threshold for the low-confidence flag; calibrated on the validation split (Goal 9). Never tuned on the test split.

source_notes.fashionpedia: length and fit from the main garment mask; neckline joined image-level from neckline part masks only on single-upper-garment images; sleeve labels unused (effectively absent).
source_notes.shopping100k: category/fit/sleevelen/collar/neckline/fastening directly; NO length attribute -> length axis relies on manual labels in the flat golden pool.
source_notes.missing_labels: -1 or unmappable value = no label; missing-label loss masking is applied during training.
